import numpy as np

def forward_kl(p, u):
    """Calculate KL(P||U) = Σ P(i) * log(P(i) / U(i))"""
    epsilon = 1e-15
    p_safe = np.maximum(p, epsilon)
    u_safe = np.maximum(u, epsilon)
    return np.sum(p * np.log(p_safe / u_safe))

def backward_kl(p, u):
    """Calculate KL(U||P) = Σ U(i) * log(U(i) / P(i))"""
    epsilon = 1e-15
    p_safe = np.maximum(p, epsilon)
    u_safe = np.maximum(u, epsilon)
    return np.sum(u * np.log(u_safe / p_safe))

def ultra_precise_search(vocab_size=150000, target_kl=10.0, tolerance=0.001):
    """
    Ultra-precise search around the best found exponent.
    We found that exponent ≈ 1.9597 gives very good results.
    """
    
    print(f"Ultra-precise search for V={vocab_size}")
    
    V = vocab_size
    u = np.ones(V) / V
    
    # Start around the best known exponent
    center_exp = 1.9597
    
    best_solution = None
    best_error = float('inf')
    
    # Multiple rounds of increasingly fine search
    search_ranges = [
        (0.01, 1000),   # ±0.01 range, 1000 points
        (0.001, 2000),  # ±0.001 range, 2000 points
        (0.0001, 1000), # ±0.0001 range, 1000 points
    ]
    
    for search_range, num_points in search_ranges:
        search_space = np.linspace(center_exp - search_range, center_exp + search_range, num_points)
        
        print(f"Searching {num_points} points in range [{center_exp - search_range:.6f}, {center_exp + search_range:.6f}]")
        
        for i, exp in enumerate(search_space):
            if i % 200 == 0:
                progress = 100 * i / len(search_space)
                print(f"  Progress: {progress:.1f}% (current best error: {best_error:.6f})")
            
            indices = np.arange(1, V + 1, dtype=np.float64)
            
            try:
                p = 1.0 / np.power(indices, exp)
                if not np.all(np.isfinite(p)):
                    continue
                p = p / np.sum(p)
                
                fkl = forward_kl(p, u)
                bkl = backward_kl(p, u)
                
                error = abs(fkl - target_kl) + abs(bkl - target_kl)
                
                if error < best_error:
                    best_error = error
                    best_solution = (p.copy(), fkl, bkl, exp)
                    
                    if error < tolerance:
                        print(f"\n🎉 Found solution within tolerance!")
                        print(f"  Exponent: {exp:.8f}")
                        print(f"  Forward KL: {fkl:.6f} (error: {abs(fkl - target_kl):.6f})")
                        print(f"  Backward KL: {bkl:.6f} (error: {abs(bkl - target_kl):.6f})")
                        print(f"  Total error: {error:.6f}")
                        return best_solution
                        
            except (OverflowError, RuntimeWarning):
                continue
        
        if best_solution is not None:
            _, _, _, new_center = best_solution
            center_exp = new_center
            print(f"  New center for next round: {center_exp:.8f}, best error: {best_error:.6f}")
    
    return best_solution

def post_process_distribution(p, u, target_kl=10.0, tolerance=0.001):
    """
    Apply small post-processing adjustments to improve the solution.
    """
    
    print("Post-processing distribution...")
    
    p_best = p.copy()
    fkl_best = forward_kl(p_best, u)
    bkl_best = backward_kl(p_best, u)
    error_best = abs(fkl_best - target_kl) + abs(bkl_best - target_kl)
    
    print(f"Starting post-processing with error: {error_best:.6f}")
    
    # Try small multiplicative adjustments to the first few elements
    for adjustment_factor in np.linspace(0.99, 1.01, 100):
        for num_elements in [1, 2, 3, 5]:
            
            p_test = p.copy()
            
            # Adjust the first few elements
            p_test[:num_elements] *= adjustment_factor
            
            # Renormalize
            p_test = p_test / np.sum(p_test)
            
            fkl_test = forward_kl(p_test, u)
            bkl_test = backward_kl(p_test, u)
            error_test = abs(fkl_test - target_kl) + abs(bkl_test - target_kl)
            
            if error_test < error_best:
                error_best = error_test
                p_best = p_test.copy()
                fkl_best = fkl_test
                bkl_best = bkl_test
                
                print(f"  Improvement: adjustment={adjustment_factor:.4f}, elements={num_elements}, error={error_test:.6f}")
                
                if error_test < tolerance:
                    print(f"  Post-processing achieved target tolerance!")
                    return p_best, fkl_best, bkl_best
    
    # Try additive adjustments
    for delta in np.linspace(-1e-6, 1e-6, 100):
        for num_elements in [1, 2, 3]:
            
            p_test = p.copy()
            
            # Add small delta to first elements, subtract from others
            p_test[:num_elements] += delta
            remaining_mass = -delta * num_elements
            p_test[num_elements:] += remaining_mass / (len(p_test) - num_elements)
            
            # Check validity
            if np.any(p_test <= 0):
                continue
                
            # Renormalize
            p_test = p_test / np.sum(p_test)
            
            fkl_test = forward_kl(p_test, u)
            bkl_test = backward_kl(p_test, u)
            error_test = abs(fkl_test - target_kl) + abs(bkl_test - target_kl)
            
            if error_test < error_best:
                error_best = error_test
                p_best = p_test.copy()
                fkl_best = fkl_test
                bkl_best = bkl_test
                
                if error_test < tolerance:
                    print(f"  Post-processing achieved target tolerance!")
                    return p_best, fkl_best, bkl_best
    
    print(f"Post-processing completed. Final error: {error_best:.6f}")
    return p_best, fkl_best, bkl_best

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("Final precise solution attempt")
    print("="*60)
    
    # Ultra-precise search
    result = ultra_precise_search()
    
    if result is not None:
        dist, fkl, bkl, exp = result
        
        print(f"\nBest ultra-precise result:")
        print(f"  Exponent: {exp:.8f}")
        print(f"  Forward KL: {fkl:.6f} (error: {abs(fkl - 10.0):.6f})")
        print(f"  Backward KL: {bkl:.6f} (error: {abs(bkl - 10.0):.6f})")
        
        # Try post-processing
        u = np.ones(150000) / 150000
        dist_final, fkl_final, bkl_final = post_process_distribution(dist, u)
        
        tolerance = 0.001
        fkl_error = abs(fkl_final - 10.0)
        bkl_error = abs(bkl_final - 10.0)
        total_error = fkl_error + bkl_error
        
        print(f"\n" + "="*60)
        print(f"FINAL PRECISE SOLUTION:")
        print(f"Forward KL divergence: {fkl_final:.6f}")
        print(f"Backward KL divergence: {bkl_final:.6f}")
        print(f"Target: 10.0")
        print(f"Forward error: {fkl_error:.6f}")
        print(f"Backward error: {bkl_error:.6f}")
        print(f"Total error: {total_error:.6f}")
        print(f"Within tolerance: {fkl_error <= tolerance and bkl_error <= tolerance}")
        
        if fkl_error <= tolerance and bkl_error <= tolerance:
            print("\n🎉 SUCCESS! Exact solution found within tolerance!")
        else:
            print(f"\n📊 Very close solution (tolerance = {tolerance})")
        
        # Save the final result
        np.save('/app/dist.npy', dist_final)
        print("\nFinal distribution saved to /app/dist.npy")
        
        # Final verification
        print(f"\nFinal verification:")
        print(f"  Sum of probabilities: {np.sum(dist_final):.12f}")
        print(f"  Max probability: {np.max(dist_final):.8f}")
        print(f"  Min probability: {np.min(dist_final):.15f}")
        print(f"  Shape: {dist_final.shape}")
        print(f"  All probabilities positive: {np.all(dist_final > 0)}")
        
        # Double-check by recomputing KL divergences
        fkl_check = forward_kl(dist_final, u)
        bkl_check = backward_kl(dist_final, u)
        print(f"\nDouble-check computation:")
        print(f"  Forward KL: {fkl_check:.6f}")
        print(f"  Backward KL: {bkl_check:.6f}")
        
    else:
        print("No valid solution found in ultra-precise search")
